entries.text: This scan turned up 20 issues across 5 pages, and every one is critical or serious (3 critical, 17 serious). Start with the footer social icon links: the shared footer in src/Shell.jsx wraps icon graphics in links that carry no readable text, so screen readers announce nothing for them, and one fix to that shared footer clears all 15 elements at once. That leaves five one-off issues to pick up next: low-contrast text on two pages, an image with no description, an unlabeled form field, and a dropdown with no name.
